context: Stamped version: 2 into this repo's .twining/config.yml (Dave's call), completing the v2 format adoption. Manual one-line edit chosen over a forward-migrate re-run — the state is already sqlite+records, so the stamp was the only delta a re-run would make, and migrate can't run under a live session.
rationale: the migrate path requires no attached sessions (this session's stdio server is attached and cannot be restarted without permanent disconnect), while on an already-migrated sqlite+records project the stamp is the ONLY change a re-run would make; the reverse-migrate exercise on the state copy confirmed re-forward produces exactly this config. Supersedes the soak-era posture of keeping version: 1 to protect the 1.24 plugin server — moot since plugin 1.12.0 bundles ^2.0.0. Consequence: any straggler 1.21–1.24 client touching this repo now goes read-only, which is the designed v2 contract.
summary: Stamped version: 2 by manual config edit instead of re-running twining-mcp migrate
